preconditions.description: The number of rows n and columns m are within the specified bounds.

preconditions.expression: all(-100 <= ai_j <= 100 for ai_j in [int(x) for row in table for x in row])
preconditions.description: Each element in the table is an integer within the specified bounds.

postconditions.description: The sum of the numbers in each row is non-negative.

postconditions.expression: all(sum(table[i][j] for i in range(n)) >= 0 for j in range(m))
postconditions.description: The sum of the numbers in each column is non-negative.

postconditions.expression: len(row_spells) == a and all(1 <= row <= n for row in row_spells) and len(set(row_spells)) == a
postconditions.description: The number of row spells a is correct, each row number is within bounds, and all row numbers are distinct.

postconditions.expression: len(col_spells) == b and all(1 <= col <= m for col in col_spells) and len(set(col_spells)) == b
postconditions.description: The number of column spells b is correct, each column number is within bounds, and all column numbers are distinct.
